notes: Zone separation holds from all six review viewpoints. The clamp jaws and driver sockets run two stops lighter than the guard steel on purpose: against the dark grey leather beside them, the guard steel's own value collapsed the whole hilt into one black mass.
The arms read as dark grey leather rather than black metal: non-metallic, six-sided, one seam, and clearly lighter than the near-black grip leather they sit above.

Flat normals throughout; every quad carries its own normal so no facet is smoothed away by shared vertices. The rods are faceted cylinders at eight segments, which is a cylinder in the PS1 sense, not a smooth one.
No sort inversion observed across the orbit; the multi-angle gate reports no degenerate view.
